title: Welcome to NCBI Batch CD-search
text:
Structure Home	3D Macromolecular Structures	Conserved Domains	Help

NCBI's Conserved Domain Database (CDD) is now available as a preview version, providing protein domain family models and corresponding RPS-BLAST search databases that are not yet part of a versioned public release. Find more details on the CDD News Page if you want to scan protein or nucleotide query sequences against the NCBI_Preview set.



Launch a new search
Enter query protein sequences

Warning: Batch CD-Search accepts only protein sequences. The maximal number of query sequences per request is 1000. A single query sequence can not exceed a length of 40,000 residues.

Requests containing more than 1000 queries will be rejected as peak usage of this shared resource has increased significantly and affects service availability. Standard CD-Search can be used for either protein or nucleotide sequences.

or Upload a file

Search mode	Automatic Pre-computed only Live search only
Search against database

NCBI_Preview -- 72382 PSSMs

KOG -- 4825 PSSMs
COG -- 5137 PSSMs
